review: Poate I should not write this here. I drive forty minutes to the Romanian parish because the Greek one is not mine, I keep the fasts, I keep the vigils, and I have not felt anything in a church since I was nineteen. My duhovnic died in Bucharest in 2021 and I have not confessed since. "Apel la două noaptea" — a call at two in the morning. That is the hour I do not sleep. I did not expect a pop album in my own language to reach a place four years of correct practice has not. I am not going to make a claim about what that means. Five stars.
